_comment: OpenRouter Cost Watch config. Copy this file to ~/.openrouter-cost-watch/config.json (or your own location) and edit. Models must be exact OpenRouter model IDs from https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models. in_pct/out_pct = alert when price moves by at least this many percent; min_abs_usd = ignore absolute moves smaller than this (US$ per million tokens) to filter noise on cheap models.
